purpose: We externally validate a published heart-failure risk prediction model. The model needs individual-level histories; aggregates are not enough.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions and medications of adults with heart failure.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
